description: Use this when the person asks to change Pugi logos already shown in this conversation: other colours, a calmer or bolder mood, another icon or font, "like the second one but blue". Draws four new options from the same brief plus that change, without asking anything. Do not use for a different business name (use make_logo).

change.description: The change in the person's own words, for example "make it blue and calmer".

idempotency_key.description: A unique string for this call, reused only to retry it.

language.description: The language the person writes in, as a BCP 47 tag such as "ru".

logo_id.description: The logo_id of one of the logos to change, from the last logo result (the picked one when there is one).

name: refine_logo
title: Change the logos
